IPL founder Lalit Modi has announced that he is now a British citizen, a development that could add another layer of complexity to India's long-standing efforts to bring him back to face legal proceedings.
While British citizenship does not automatically protect an individual from extradition or legal action, it may affect the diplomatic and legal processes involved. Modi continues to face scrutiny over allegations linked to his tenure as IPL chairman, though he has consistently denied wrongdoing and rejected being labelled a fugitive.
